about_the_game:
Relaxing days. Terrifying nights.

Build tower defenses, customize your ship into a mobile base, and restore ruined towns across handcrafted islands that subtly shift with every visit. Watch once-empty streets fill with light as towers ignite, guards patrol, and corruption burns away.

Upgrade your ship, unlock powerful abilities, and automate production loops that accelerate every system you touch. Grow stronger each day, purify each fractured shore, and face a final choice only you can make.

Build and Transform Fallen Towns

  • Restore ruined forges, armor stations, trade docks, and crafting halls. Each upgrade unlocks stronger gear, new progression paths, and powerful defenses. Watch rubble rise into glowing hubs as NPCs return to work, filling streets with activity and purpose.

Defend the Night, Purify the Shore

  • When portals tear open after sunset, raiders flood the streets in escalating waves. Deploy walls, turrets, guards, and archers to crush threats that once overwhelmed you. Ignore repairs too long and towns lose access to upgrades, crafting, and defenses until reclaimed.

    Day rewards progress. Night threatens it.

Customize a Mobile Base at Sea

  • Sail an open world and upgrade your ship with crafting stations, storage modules, utilities, and defensive tools. Heavy builds become floating fortresses that shred enemy ships. Light builds remain fast and agile for rapid exploration. Larger vessels support deeper customization and visible upgrades.

Harvest, Craft, and Trade

  • Gather wood, stone, ores, and ingredients across handcrafted islands, then refine them into high-value tools, weapons, and trade goods. Sell your creations for lumen to fuel upgrades, expand towns, and strengthen defenses.

Hire Workers and Automate Production

  • Recruit laborers to gather resources and run processing stations while you explore. Your workers and defenses keep pushing your progress even when you are away from town gathering materials.

  • Automation feeds upgrades. Upgrades accelerate gathering. Gathering fuels defenses. Every system pushes the next.

Combat and Spell Synergy

  • Dash, parry, kick, and smash corrupted foes using timing-based melee combat. Enhance your spell with gems that add burning fields, healing sparks, knockbacks, and more. Only one spell and gem can be active at a time, creating meaningful loadout choices and powerful combat synergies.

Conquer Trials and Bosses

  • Enter corrupted portals to battle powerful bosses, purify towns, and unlock rare upgrades that push you deeper into danger. Every victory frees resources, reduces nightly pressure, and advances your foothold on each fractured shore.

Handcrafted Islands That Evolve

  • Island layouts stay readable and familiar, but merchants move, enemy camps shift, and obelisks spawn in new places. Each visit feels fresh without losing clarity.

Progress That Feels Good

  • Each shore introduces harder raids, new systems, and compounding upgrades that rise into a satisfying power curve. The longer you play, the faster you evolve.

A Rhythm of Survival

  • Explore islands by day, rebuild towns, automate production, defend raids at night, then conquer trials to unlock the next fractured shore.

A Choice That Matters

  • Your build, your ship loadout, your town layout, your defenses. Every decision shapes how you play. Your journey leads toward a decision the world has waited for — power can save… or corrupt.

~Wishlist The Shores of Stellaluna Now!~

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10/11 (64-bit Version)
  • Processor: Intel i5-750/AMD Phenom II X4-945
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia 2060 or similar
  • DirectX: Version 11
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10/11 (64-bit Version)
  • Processor: Intel i5-2400/AMD FX-8320
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia 3060
  • DirectX: Version 11

short_description: Sail a fractured open world, rebuild fallen towns, and survive escalating nightly raids with tower defenses. Upgrade your ship into a mobile base, grow your trade empire, automate production, and forge unique combat synergies as each new shore doubles the challenge in this first-person survival RPG.
